title: Oops, wrong target
story: You submitted a job called {{bad}} with the wrong target file. It's still waiting in the queue. Cancel it before it wastes a GPU.

files.~/{{project}}/run.sh:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=mpnn
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%j.out

module load anaconda
conda activate proteinmpnn

python /opt/ProteinMPNN/protein_mpnn_run.py \
  --pdb_path inputs/target.pdb \
  --out_folder outputs/

hints: `squeue --me` shows the JOBID. `scancel JOBID` cancels it.
`squeue --me`, then `scancel` with the number in the JOBID column.
